steps.content: Behind you, a wooden frame suddenly shatters. A coarse hand grasps the wooden frame, and a pitch-black figure struggles desperately to get out.
He roars and struggles with all his might to escape the dream. The squirming hand that broke free from the beautiful dream keeps oozing out the black goo of misery.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: It's you...?!
Serpent leaves you and rushes toward the frame, trying to stop him from leaving.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Go back, don't force yourself! You're expelling pain! Leaving this sweet dream gives you pain, reality gives you so much pain!
Doyle doesn't answer. He roars mournfully and grabs tightly onto Serpent as he tries to break free from the frame. Half of his body is already out, and the whole frame begins to spew out black goo.
The black goo sears Serpent's body. She looks like she's in pain, but she doesn't let go, nor does she attack the out-of-control Sleepwalker.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Sob... Why... Stop, go back... Don't come out...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You'll only be happy if you stay... I tried so hard to give you happiness... Don't you want to see Nasha?!

The mention of this name triggers a hysterical roar from Doyle as he struggles feverishly to get out. A few more picture frames tremble as others also try to break the boundary between dream and reality to get out.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I don't understand. What did I miss? What's missing from the dream?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: The things that are not happy are missing.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There are many things in the real world that people won't easily let go of. There will always be those who cherish things other than happiness.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You say that I have no right to force others to abandon their dreams and return to reality, but the same goes for you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You have no right to decide for them. You have no right to destroy reality and imprison everyone in their dreams.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Haha... You're trying to sway ME this time? You sly fox. You're trying to repeat your old tricks and shake my will to change the rules of this realm?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You can't fool me. You haven't experienced that kind of joy, nor have you experienced the darkest of nights... You have no idea how precious it is!

A ray of blue light flashes before you and slices off the hair in front of your forehead. Serpent is showing anger for the first time, but even so, she doesn't do anything to the people in her frames.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your opponent is Doyle, and everyone else to whom you force-fed happiness and robbed of freedom. Go fight against them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My opponent is over there!
You force yourself up and focus your mind to face the monster creeping in the dark—"Marv," the source of Ambrosia and all the mutations.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Are you thinking of... No! Get out!!
She immediately realizes your intentions. The Realm of Dreams twists and pushes toward you as she shrieks. She wants to expel you from her realm.
Your innards start to burn, but you can't stop. You yell at the writhing monster...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't you want my power? Don't you want the Corpus inside my body? Then rebel against her and come get me!
You shout loudly at the monster in the dark, beckoning and provoking it. Even if it can't understand human words, you must attract its attention, so that it will target you as its prey...
Finally, it starts to squirm with a mad glimmer in its eyes. This monster is spliced   from all sorts of debris, and the radiant spiritual contamination gluing it together turns out to be Ambrosia!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Marv! Stay away from him! Back down!
steps.female_content: Marv! Stay away from her! Back down!

steps.content: But the monster's desire for you overturns Serpent's commands. The two sets of willpower constructing this dream clash with each other, tearing the world apart. Your shackles are back.
Fight it, even though it frightens and disgusts you. People must always face some undesirable things to get what they want. Plus...
You won't lose.
